paper.title: 15th International Geography Olympiad — Québec City, Canada — 31 July – 6 August, 2018 — FIELDWORK EXERCISE 2

documentNotes.title: General Instructions
documentNotes.statement:
Students schooled in English will have 2 hours to write this test.

Students not schooled in English will be provided with 20 extra minutes.

There is a section relating to each of the two field work areas explored.

Read the documents provided for each section, which provide good context for your answers.

Using your rough map from the fieldwork (**Map A2**) and the classification from the **Table C1 (**above**),** create **a neat map** on the template (**Map C1 separate sheet**). (10 marks)

Use colours and/or symbols as appropriate.

Your map should include:

a. Artist Statues

b. types and locations of other features and businesses that highlight the art and historical theme of tourism in this town (based on your classification)

c. a legend or key

d. a scale shown as a ratio (eg. 1:20)

The citizens of Baie-Saint-Paul have stated how important the appearance and the cultural heritage of their town is to them. They say it is the basis of tourism in the area. (3 marks)

On the map you have drawn, **Map C1,** delineate the zones of cultural heritage landscape that could help inform tourists or town planners of the status of the cultural landscape. Include the following zones:

A. The **CORE** AREA- rich cultural landscape (high density of features or art heritage elements),

B. The **PERIPHERY** AREA - Moderate cultural landscape (moderate density of features or art heritage elements),

C. Areas requiring immediate attention (this should include the three areas you identified on the trip yesterday).

The citizens’ responses to the landscape survey are shown in **Tables C3, C4 and C5 on page 6**.

problems.title: TASK 2: Boisé du Quai – Bay Area
problems.statement:
This task is worth 20 marks.

**Instructions**

The Bay area is the favourite landscape of the citizens of Baie-Saint-Paul. They want to develop the recreation facilities and increase protection of the area.

**Read** the responses to the survey in **Tables C2, C3, C4, C5 and C6 (pages 6 and 7).**

Consider the citizens’ responses to the survey, and your own knowledge about the different environments at this site.

parts.statement:
**Design** a land use plan for the Boisé du Quai area on the template map provided (**Map C2 on a separate sheet**) with the following considerations:

a. It must reflect the goals of the community in both development and protection.

b. It must allow people easily to access all the different landscapes at the site.

c. It must include a heavy use recreational space.

d. It must indicate which areas are most sensitive and need to be protected.

Sketch the features that your plan will include onto the template map **(Map C2).**

**Annotate** your suggestions to justify your choices. No additional text or writing is permitted.

**END OF THE TEST**
